objective.text: Stop an unauthorized operation with authorize instead of ignoring a boolean policy result.

difficulty.rationale: Make a failed permission check interrupt the operation instead of discarding its result.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An action calls Gate::allows("publish", $post) as a standalone statement, ignores its return value, then publishes. Which standalone replacement stops the action on denial under normal handling?

options.rationale: denies returns a boolean; ignoring it still lets the action continue.
options.misconception: denies returns a boolean; ignoring it still lets the action continue.

options.rationale: check reports a boolean result rather than throwing on a denied ability.
options.misconception: check reports a boolean result rather than throwing on a denied ability.

options.rationale: authorize throws an AuthorizationException when the ability is denied, interrupting the action.
inspect returns an authorization response for the caller to examine; simply discarding it does not enforce denial.
options.misconception: inspect returns an authorization response for the caller to examine; simply discarding it does not enforce denial.
